headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool in contact over Monaco's Camara
description: Liverpool have reached out to representatives of Lamine Camara and will explore a transfer next summer. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Crystal Palace's Ismaïla Sarr set to be sidelined for weeks, Pierre Sage confirms
description: Ismaïla Sarr is likely to remain sidelined with a groin issue until after the international break, Crystal Palace boss Pierre Sage has confirmed.

headline: Man City, Bayern among the good, bad and lucky in Europe's top leagues
description: We're a quarter of the way through the 2026-27 European season -- long enough to separate fact from fiction when it comes to from. Who's been lucky? Who's been good? Who's been both, or neither?

headline: Michael Carrick: Bruno Fernandes retains Man United captaincy
description: Manchester United manager Michael Carrick said Bruno Fernandes will keep the team's captaincy, despite his decision to drop the midfielder for their 3-0 defeat vs. Bournemouth.

headline: Michael Carrick: 'Not surprised' to still be Man United manager
description: Michael Carrick said he is "not surprised" to still be in a job as Manchester United manager, despite the team failing to win any of its past eight games.
